code:
Prelude> :l functions.hs
Prelude> double 7          -- 14
Prelude> add 3 4           -- 7
Prelude> add5 10           -- 15
Prelude> square 9          -- 81
description: You load functions.hs with :l, then call the functions defined in that file.

steps.description: The :l command loads the file into GHCi.
You supply one argument to double and two to add. add 3 4 groups as (add 3) 4.
add5 needs its remaining argument. square applies the anonymous function defined in the file.

title: Load and call functions
